rationale: The Court is likely to adopt a duty- and class-of-workers-focused rule under Saxon and Circuit City, rejecting a supply-chain/continuous-flow goods-tracing test that would be hard to administer and risk letting the §1 exemption swallow the FAA. Sotomayor likely dissents to argue that last-mile drivers can be transportation workers engaged in interstate commerce when their regular duties complete a coordinated interstate journey.
